newsitem.title: INDIA: Kashmir separatists kill five pro-India militants.
newsitem.headline: Kashmir separatists kill five pro-India militants.

text.p: Separatist guerrillas fired rockets at a pro-government militia group in India's troubled state of Jammu and Kashmir and killed five people, police said on Sunday.

The separatists attacked a house at Baramulla, 55 km (34 miles) north of the state's summer capital Srinagar, late on Saturday and killed members of Ikhwan-ul-Muslimoon, a group of former separatist guerrillas now supporting India.
Ikhwan-ul-Muslimoon is headed by Kuka Parray, who was recently elected to the state's assembly in local elections held after a gap of nine years.
The guerrillas destroyed the house and kidnapped three of the group's militants, police said.
More than a dozen militant groups are fighting New Delhi's rule in Jammu and Kashmir, with at least three groups helping Indian paramilitary forces combat the separatists.
More than 20,000 people have been killed during the separatist war in the Himalayan state, the only province with a Moslem majority in mainly Hindu India.
Separatists killed six pro-government militants earlier this month in a village near Baramulla.
